MemoryConfig.description:
Memory backend configuration (`[memory]` section).

Controls conversation memory storage, embeddings, hybrid search, response
caching, and memory snapshot/hydration. Backend-specific connection settings
live under `[storage.<backend>.<alias>]`; this section selects which storage
instance to use via the `backend` dotted reference.

archive_after_days.description: Move daily/session files to the archive directory after this many days. Keeps the hot working set small without deleting history.

audit_enabled.description: Enable audit logging of memory operations.

audit_retention_days.description: Retention period for audit entries in days (default: 30).

auto_hydrate.description: Auto-hydrate from MEMORY_SNAPSHOT.md when brain.db is missing

auto_reindex_on_identity_change.description: Automatically re-embed all memories in the background when a change of embedding provider/model/dimensions is detected at startup (after the stale vectors have been cleared). Costs one embedding API call per memory, so it's off by default — leave it off for large stores and run `zeroclaw memory reindex` explicitly instead.

auto_save.description: Auto-save what *you* tell ZeroClaw into memory as conversation history — the agent's own replies are not saved. Turn off if you want memory to only hold things you explicitly record via the memory tool.

backend.description:
Dotted reference to the active storage instance: `<backend>.<alias>`
(e.g. `"sqlite.default"`, `"postgres.work"`). Resolves through
`Config.storage.<backend>.<alias>` at runtime. Bare backend names
(`"sqlite"`) are treated as `"<backend>.default"`. Set to `"none"` to
disable persistence entirely.

candidate_multiplier.description:
Candidate pool multiplier over the final recall limit before blend/rerank trimming.
Values must be in 1..=20; runtime also enforces a bounded candidate pool.

chunk_max_tokens.description: Max tokens per chunk for document splitting

conflict_supersede_enabled.description: Enable reversible supersede soft-hide machinery when wired.

conflict_threshold.description: Cosine similarity threshold for conflict detection (0.0–1.0).

consolidation_extract_facts.description:
Also extract atomic durable facts from each consolidated turn and store
them as individual Core memories. Default off; the flip is sequenced in
a later phase. SQLite-only: enabling this requires the sqlite memory
backend globally and on every agent (validated at config load).

conversation_retention_days.description: Delete conversation rows older than this many days from the DB (sqlite backend only). Age is measured by `updated_at` (last write time). 0 = keep forever.

core_max_bytes.description: Maximum Core bytes before budget compaction. 0 = unbounded.

core_max_rows.description: Maximum Core rows before budget compaction. 0 = unbounded.

core_retention_days.description: Delete core memory rows older than this many days from the DB. Age is measured by `created_at` (first-write time). Neither recall nor ordinary rewrites refresh `created_at` under the current SQLite upsert, so core retention is an absolute age limit from first write. Set this to a generously large window for durable core memories, or keep 0 = keep forever.

daily_max_rows.description: Maximum Daily rows before budget compaction. 0 = unbounded.

daily_retention_days.description: Delete daily memory rows older than this many days from the DB. Age is measured by `updated_at` (last write time). 0 = keep forever.

dedup_action.description: Action to take when a duplicate is detected.

dedup_jaccard_threshold.description: Jaccard threshold for text-only duplicate detection.

embedding_api_key.description: Optional API key for the embedding endpoint. When set, embedding calls use this key instead of inheriting one from the seed model provider — decoupling embeddings from the chat model. Use it when the chat model runs on a provider that carries no usable embedding credential (e.g. an OAuth-only provider) while embeddings keep hitting an `openai`/`custom:` endpoint with their own key. Leave unset to inherit the seed provider's key (backward-compatible default).

embedding_cache_size.description: Max embedding cache entries before LRU eviction

embedding_dimensions.description: Vector width produced by the embedding model — must match the model's native dimension or vectors won't store correctly. Look up the number on the model_provider's model page.

embedding_model.description: Embedding model identifier — must match a model your chosen embedding model_provider serves (e.g. `text-embedding-3-small` for OpenAI). Changing this invalidates existing embeddings: the change is detected at startup and stale vectors are cleared automatically; run `zeroclaw memory reindex` to re-embed (or set `auto_reindex_on_identity_change`).

embedding_provider.description: Source of embedding vectors for semantic search. `none` = keyword-only retrieval (no API calls, no vector cost); `openai` = OpenAI's embedding API; `custom:URL` = any OpenAI-compatible embedding endpoint (LiteLLM, local gateway, etc.).

fts_early_return_score.description:
Reserved (0.0-1.0): the FTS score above which recall would skip the
vector stage. Inert until the backend exposes distinct FTS and vector
operations; recall is a single hybrid call today, so this has no effect.

hygiene_enabled.description: Run the periodic hygiene pass that archives stale daily/session files and enforces retention windows. Leave on unless you want to manage cleanup yourself.

importance_weight.description: Importance weight used by the recall blend.

keyword_weight.description: How heavily BM25 (keyword) overlap counts when `search_mode = hybrid`. Raise toward 1.0 for exact-term matching; lower it when paraphrases should still score well.

min_relevance_score.description:
Minimum hybrid score (0.0–1.0) for a memory to be included in context.
Memories scoring below this threshold are dropped to prevent irrelevant
context from bleeding into conversations. Default: 0.4

mmr_lambda.description: MMR relevance-vs-diversity weight, where 1.0 means relevance-only.

pin_min_importance.description: Pin entries at or above this importance. >1.0 means disabled.

purge_after_days.description: Delete archived files permanently after this many days. Set high if you need long-term history; set low for privacy / disk-space reasons.

recency_weight.description: Recency weight used by the recall blend.

rerank_enabled.description:
Enable the recall rerank stage: blend retrieval score with importance
and recency, collapse near-duplicate entries, then trim back to the
recall limit. The advanced strategy below runs when the candidate
count reaches `rerank_threshold`.

rerank_threshold.description: Minimum candidate count to trigger the advanced rerank strategy.

response_cache_enabled.description: Enable LLM response caching to avoid paying for duplicate prompts

response_cache_hot_entries.description: Max in-memory hot cache entries for the two-tier response cache (default: 256)

response_cache_max_entries.description: Max number of cached responses before LRU eviction (default: 5000)

response_cache_ttl_minutes.description: TTL in minutes for cached responses (default: 60)

retrieval_stages.description:
Retrieval stages for per-agent recall. Only `"cache"` is active: it
enables an in-process, per-handle hot cache over recall results and is
omitted from the default so recall stays coherent across handles.
`"fts"` and `"vector"` are reserved for when the backend exposes
distinct FTS and vector operations; recall is a single hybrid backend
call today, so those names have no effect (kept for forward compat).

search_mode.description: How memories are retrieved: `bm25` = keyword-only (no embeddings, cheapest); `embedding` = vector similarity only (needs an embedding model_provider); `hybrid` = blended keyword + vector score using the weights above (most robust).

snapshot_enabled.description: Enable periodic export of core memories to MEMORY_SNAPSHOT.md

vector_weight.description: How heavily vector (semantic) similarity counts when `search_mode = hybrid`. Raise toward 1.0 to favor meaning-based matches; lower it to lean on keyword overlap instead.

MemoryDedupAction.description: Write-time duplicate handling policy for memory entries.

oneOf.description: Merge an incoming near-duplicate into a survivor.

read_only_namespaces.description: Namespaces that are read-only (writes are rejected).

redact_categories.description: Redaction categories applied when `redact_on_write` is true.

redact_on_write.description: Redact configured secret/PII categories before persistence.

retention_days_by_category.description: Retention days by category (overrides global). Keys: "core", "daily", "conversation".

threat_scan.description: Content scan mode for durable memory writes: "off", "on", or "strict".

threat_scan_load_time.description: Re-scan stored entries at recall/read time and withhold flagged entries.

threat_scan_on_hit.description:
Behavior when a write-time content scan matches: "reject" or
"block-on-read".

MemoryTypesConfig.description:
Typed memory configuration (`[memory.types]` section).

Behaviour-neutral by default: `enabled` gates MemoryKind assignment on new
consolidation writes and defaults off; the flip is sequenced in a later
phase. SQLite-only: enabling requires the sqlite memory backend globally
and on every agent (validated at config load).

enabled.description: Assign a first-class MemoryKind to new consolidation writes.

description: Memory backend configuration: sqlite, markdown, embeddings (`[memory]`).
